summary: stdcall wrapper that copies the global track-name buffer (aTrackname) into a caller-provided destination via StringCopyWithValidation, passing the read-only global as the source and a zero constant as the final argument. Returns the copy helper's result unchanged. Called from server session, game-filter and two unnamed setup paths.

operations.description: Invoke StringCopyWithValidation(a1, a2, (int)aTrackname, 0), copying from the read-only global track-name buffer aTrackname (at 0x005C6984) into the caller destination a1 using source a2.

Invoked by session/server setup paths (ServerOpenTrackSignal, ServerOpenedClosedNotification, GameFilterSetup) and two unnamed callers to read or refresh the track name during track open and notification handling.

unresolved: Meaning of the final StringCopyWithValidation argument (0) is unknown; likely a length cap or formatting flag.
The owner of the global track-name buffer is unknown.
